name: Ardèche
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A French PGI for the Ardèche, where Syrah covers about 30% of the vineyard area, followed by Grenache at 19% and Merlot at 14%. Viognier and Chardonnay each cover 7%.
